CITY of AZUSA PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES

  September 25, 2019
  7:00 p.m.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports for the Planning Commission projects will
be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the
Planning Division and during regular hours at the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any
agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5289. The Planning Commission
Meeting will be held at 7:00 p.m. in the Civic Auditorium located at 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa,
California.

A)  CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Avila called the meeting to order at 7:00 pm.

B)  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Allen led the pledge of allegiance.

C)  ROLL CALL

  Members Present: AVILA, ALLEN, DONNELSON, LEE and RAMIREZ
  Members Absent: NONE
  Staff Present: Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, Dean Flores, Assistant Planner and Elijio
  Sandoval, Planning Technician

D)  MINUTES

1.  August 14, 2019

  Commissioner Ramirez made motion to approve the August 14, 2019 Planning
  Commission Minutes. Commissioner Allen seconded. The item was approved with the
  following vote:

  AYES: AVILA, ALLEN, DONNELSON, LEE, RAMIREZ
  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE

E)  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION - (Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up
  to five (5) minutes in compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  September 19, 2019
  Page 2

  response to questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her
  comments).

  None.

F)  PUBLIC MEETING

  1. Case No.:  DR-2018-13, LM-2019-02
  Location:  820 N. Soldano Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
  APN:  8608-028-011, -012
  Applicant:  JWDA-MS Architects

  The City of Azusa received a request for a Design Review (DR-2019-13) to construct a
  6-unit townhome development and a Lot Merger (LM-2019-02) to merge two parcels into
  one.

  This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 32 Categorical
  Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, introduces Dean Flores, Assistant Planner and
  corrects, for the record, the entitlement number to read DR-2019-13 not DR-2018-13.

  Dean Flores, Assistant Planner, presents the item.

  Chair Avila invited the applicant to speak

  Michael Sun, Representative from JWDA-MS Architects, introduced himself and
  addressed Water Division condition #19 and future negotiation with said Division.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, elaborated on the correction process and explains the,
  after the fact, condition received from Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation
  Authority.

  Commissioner Allen, ask about the existence of Metro gates.

  Commissioner Donnelson expands on gate existence and thanks the applicant for the
  project.

  Commissioner Lee asks staff about what can be done about Water Division Condition
  #19 and what can be done.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, responds to Commissioner Lee.

  Commissioner Ramirez commented on the project
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  September 19, 2019
  Page 3

  Chair Avila comments on the design and asks staff if they received any letters from the
  public.
  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, responds to Chair Avila

  Commissioner Allen made a motion. Commissioner Ramirez seconded. The item was
  approved with the following vote:

  AYES: AVILA, ALLEN, DONNELSON, LEE, RAMIREZ
  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE

2. Case No.:  DR-2019-14, TTM-82805
  Location:  300 W. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa CA 91702
  APN:  8616-005-001, -002
  Applicant:  JWDA-MS Architects

  The City of Azusa received a request for a Design Review (DR-2019-14) to construct a
  mixed-use project consisting of a 633 square-foot commercial building, 447 square-foot
  community gym building, and a 7-unit attached townhome development with two-car
  garages for each unit and Tentative Tract Map for commercial and residential
  condominium purposes and to merge two parcels into one.

  This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 32 Categorical
  Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, introduces Dean Flores, Assistant Planner.

  Dean Flores, Assistant Planner, presents the item.

  Commissioner Ramirez asks staff about the public art feature.

  Manuel Muñoz, responds to Commissioner Ramirez.

  Chair Avila asks staff about the adjacent parcel’s building frontage and about project
  location merger history.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, and Dean Flores, Assistant Planner, both respond to
  Chair Avila.

  Commissioner Lee asks about previous version of the project and its use of elevators and
  this current project’s ADA compliance.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, responds to Commissioner Lee.

  Commissioner Ramirez compliments the project.
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  September 19, 2019
  Page 4

  Commissioner Donnelson compliments the project and ask about landscaping on and off
  site.

  Michael Sun, Representative from JWDA-MS Architects, responds to Planning
  Commission and explains issue with Water Division’s condition.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, responds and expands on issue with water pressure in
  the area.

  Commissioner Donnelson made a motion. Commissioner Ramirez seconded. The item
  was approved with the following vote:

  AYES: AVILA, ALLEN, DONNELSON, LEE, RAMIREZ
  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE

G)  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

H)  NEW BUSINESS

  None.

I)  REPORTS AND COMMUNICATION

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, provide commissioners with and update on the
  Orchard project, investment group agreement, Consolidated Ready Mix, and Raising
  Cane’s Restaurant.

J)  DISCUSSION ITEMS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSIONERS

  Commissioner Lee asked about possible costs and complications caused by conditioned
  such as the ones required by the Water Division on items F-1 and F-2.

  Manuel Munoz, Planning Manager, responds.

K)  ADJOURNMENT

  Chair Avila adjourned the meeting at 7:45 pm

UPCOMING MEETING: October 9, 2019

  Except as specifically provided, public hearing items are appealable to the
  City Council in accordance with the provisions of the City Code.

this meeting, please contact the Economic and Community Development Department - Planning Division,

  accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35.102.104 ADA Title II).
